decisions.reason: The camera builds directly on the firm's decades of optical and star-tracker heritage, so management can readily interpret early mission feedback and refine it through its own R&D, which justifies keeping it in a growing market.

This modular navigation camera line fits the firm's strategy of compact, flexible sensors for small satellites and rests on existing optoelectronic know-how, so the firm can absorb customer learning across its several models.

Space situational awareness extends the firm's sensor base into an adjacent, growing field, and its university and EU research cooperation gives it the related knowledge to assimilate and improve the suite, despite more uncertainty than the core products.

The miniaturized LiDAR draws on the firm's docking and rendezvous sensor expertise and its R&D capacity, so although the website only mentions it, the long space qualification cycles and strategic fit with smaller spacecraft favour continuing it.
